segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I saw your note about adding the support team before the July renewal, so I figured we could just walk through seats and timing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that’s right. We’re at 42 seats today, and we need to add 18 more for the Denver support group. Ideally they’re live by June 24.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. Your current term runs through July 31, so we can co-term the 18 seats for the remainder of the term, then roll all 60 into the renewal starting August 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. What does that do to the invoice? Finance asked me to avoid a separate long contract if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. For the prorated add-on, it’s $4,860 before tax for June 24 through July 31. Then the renewal would be 60 seats at $68 per user per month, billed annually, so $48,960 for the year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I expected. Any change to our contract terms, or is it just the order form?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Just the order form. Same master agreement, same payment terms, net 30. I’ll include the prorated line and the renewal line so it’s clear for your AP team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. We’ll need the invoice sent to ap@northlineparts.com, and the PO number should be PO-4178.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I’ll put PO-4178 on the order form and invoice. For enablement, do you want the 18 users provisioned on June 24, or should we open them a few days early for training?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Open them June 20 if that’s okay. Training is scheduled the morning of the 21st.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, no issue. I’ll set access for June 20, include the admin instructions, and send the order form later today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy Luis in procurement. If it looks like what we discussed, I can sign by Friday.
